title: The BuddyBoss Addons plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account… (CVE-2026-80188)
description: The BuddyBoss Addons plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 1.2.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers who know a user's email address to link their own social login identity to that user's account, including administrator accounts, enabling account takeover. Exploitation requires the BuddyBoss Platform plugin with the Social Login module and a selected provider enabled. On sites using the BuddyBoss App JWT component, the vulnerability can yield an application token immediately.
